title: LUKTVICKER comforter set
description: LUKTVICKER comforter set, green, King A set in timeless green with a waffle structure where the comforter’s wonderfully soft cotton shell breathes and its fluffy filling feels like a soft embrace. 100% cotton fabric that breathes and feels wonderfully soft against your skin.
features: Comprises: 1 King size comforter 108x92'' (274x234 cm) and 2 King size pillow shams 20x36'' (51x91 cm).
Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
The roll-packed, compressed comforter regains its original shape and fluffiness after a few days.
Filling density is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling density, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
materialAndCare: Top fabric/ Back fabric: 100 % cotton; Filling: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)
